summary: Tested Feel SXM marketing site end-to-end. Backend (root + bookings CRUD/validation) 100% passing via pytest. Frontend tested via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: home/boats/activities/about routes, header desktop+mobile, footer links, booking form submission with backend save and WhatsApp popup all working. 19/22 Playwright assertions passed; the 3 'failures' are test-side strictness issues (concatenated text_content without span spacing, popup URL is api.whatsapp.com after wa.me redirect, boat_prefilled queried before useEffect hydration), not product bugs. One real minor issue: the 👋 emoji in WhatsApp message body shows as U+FFFD (replacement char) in the opened URL even though source is UTF-8 — likely CRA/webpack build encoding quirk.

integration_issues.issue: Wave emoji 👋 in pre-filled WhatsApp message body is encoded as U+FFFD (%EF%BF%BD) in the opened URL, even though Book.jsx source contains correct UTF-8 \xf0\x9f\x91\x8b. Build/bundle likely re-encoding the file. Functional flow still works (wa.me opens correctly).

action_items: Optional: fix the 👋 emoji encoding in Book.jsx buildMessage so the wave emoji renders correctly in the WhatsApp pre-filled message (e.g., use unicode escape '\uD83D\uDC4B' or ensure source file is read as UTF-8 by the bundler).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/bookings GET silently swallows ISO-parse errors and substitutes datetime.now() — could mask real data corruption; consider logging the exception.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers (FastAPI ≥0.110).
Booking persistence stores created_at as ISO string but list endpoint coerces back to datetime — consider storing as native BSON datetime to avoid the round-trip.
Book.jsx swallows backend POST errors silently (only console.warn). Lead may be lost without user awareness; consider surfacing a non-blocking warning.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test bookings prefixed with 'TEST_' inserted via POST /api/bookings during pytest and frontend e2e
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root + bookings (valid create, invalid email 422, missing required 422, list desc sort with no _id leakage). Frontend e2e covered: hero CTA, nav links, mobile menu (<1024px), boats filters + request-boat prefill, activities, about, footer links, booking form submit with WhatsApp window.open + success state. All required data-testids present and reliable. Use page.context.expect_page() to capture WhatsApp popup.
